claim.purpose: Upgrade deprecated Node 20 GitHub Action pins to reviewed Node 24 revisions

initial.title: [v0.91.7][ci] Upgrade pinned Actions away from deprecated Node 20 runtime
initial.goal: Remove GitHub Actions Node 20 compatibility forcing while preserving immutable pinning.
initial.required_outcome: Every annotated action pin uses a reviewed Node 24 revision and a hosted run contains no Node 20 deprecation annotation.
authority_boundary: Official action repositories and immutable commit SHAs are release authority
Repository runtime contracts preserve canonical pin policy
initial.task_boundary: Replace only annotated Node 20 action pins, strengthen their static contract, retain inventory, and prove hosted annotations absent.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: All checkout occurrences use reviewed checkout v7 Node 24 commit
AC2: All upload-artifact occurrences use reviewed v7 Node 24 commit
AC3: All rust-cache occurrences use reviewed v2.9.1 Node 24 commit
AC4: Deprecated SHAs are absent and immutable full-SHA policy remains enforced
AC5: A GitHub-hosted PR run emits no Node.js 20 deprecation annotation
dependencies: GitHub-hosted Actions runner and official action release metadata
initial.plan_summary: Inventory annotated pins, replace them with reviewed Node 24 commits, strengthen static contracts, and inspect hosted PR annotations.

steps.action: Inventory annotated revisions and verify official Node 24 replacement commits
Replace pins and strengthen canonical immutable-SHA contracts
Run static proof and inspect hosted PR annotations

risks: Major action upgrades may change inputs or outputs
A partial replacement can leave compatibility forcing in less-used workflows
invariants: Every third-party action remains pinned to 40-hex commit
Workflow behavior outside action runtime upgrades is unchanged
stop_conditions: Official action metadata does not declare Node 24
Replacement release has incompatible behavior requiring broader CI design
review_prompts: Do major upgrades preserve used inputs and outputs?
Does the static contract reject deprecated or floating pins?

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove canonical pins and deprecated-SHA absence
Prove Node 20 deprecation annotations are absent

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on floating pins, partial replacement, contract failure, incompatible action inputs, or any hosted Node 20 deprecation annotation.
